notes: Big 3D update: authentic jerseys for all 32 clubs (real crests, wordmarks, shoulder patches, stripes and lettering); authentic NHL benches and penalty boxes with players seated, climbing over the boards on line changes and using the box doors; smoother stickhandling (blade on the ice, no glove flips, passes land on the stick); referees watch the play; no more flashes on the bench; smarter on-ice AI (dump-ins, defensive coverage, shot choices, passing lanes).
